Havertz Arsenal 1 table D. Rice Arsenal 1 construction · score 7.7 Arsenal still have a chance to chase the top spot when they visit Liverpool at Anfield at 11:30 PM on November 1st, 2026. The visitors are currently second with 21 points, while Liverpool are fifth with 15 points. The six-point difference means any slip-up in the race above them will be significant.
 Arsenal maintain their high position, Liverpool need to move up.
 On the league table, Arsenal are in the leading group and are directly chasing the top spot. Therefore, their ticket to Anfield carries a clear objective: to maintain their lead over the teams above them and prevent their rivals from closing in.
 Liverpool are in fifth place, six points behind Arsenal. For the home team, this match is an opportunity to close the gap with a higher-ranked opponent right on their home ground.
 Form: Both teams are unbeaten in their last 5 matches.
 Liverpool are currently enjoying a very positive run of results. In their last five matches, they have won four, drawn one, and remained undefeated. The draw was their most recent result, following a run of four consecutive wins.
 Arsenal are also quite consistent. They have won 3, drawn 2, and remained unbeaten in their last 5 matches. However, the visitors have drawn 2 of their last 3 games, so converting those draws into wins is something they need to improve if they want to stay in contention with the top teams.
 The odds are tilted in favor of the home team.
 In their last five meetings, Liverpool have won two, drawn three, while Arsenal have yet to win. This trend suggests that encounters between the two teams are usually very balanced, but Liverpool hold a slight advantage.
 For Arsenal, it's a significant psychological challenge. If they want to chase the top spot, they need to break their winless streak against this very opponent.
 The key tactical point
 Both teams are currently unbeaten, so the match is likely to be decided by defensive solidity and the ability to capitalize on opportunities. Liverpool have the home advantage and a four-game winning streak before their last draw. This allows them to play with high confidence.
 Arsenal, being the higher-ranked team, can choose to control the tempo and minimize mistakes. In a match where three of the last five encounters have ended in a draw, scoring first could make a significant psychological difference.
 Assessment
 Both teams enter the match in nearly equal form, both unbeaten in their last five games. Liverpool have the home advantage and a slightly better head-to-head record. Arsenal, on the other hand, are higher in the league table and still harbor hopes of catching up to the top spot.
 A closely contested match with little space is the most likely scenario. The outcome could be decided by small details, given that neither team wants to slip up at this point in the season.
